lines.t: Do you ever wonder about the things in the sky—the Sun, the Moon, the stars? People have
been watching the sky for a long time, trying to figure out what is out there. We keep coming up
with new ways to learn more about outer space.
Planets are big balls of rock or gas that move around stars. We live on one we call the Earth,
which moves around a star we call the Sun. There are at least seven other planets moving
around the Sun and a lot of other smaller things as well. All these things together are called a
system. The Latin word for the Sun is Sol, so we call this system the Solar System.
